description: Feedback2Me Ops V2 — single canonical operational event model. Every observability source (health check, runtime telemetry, deploy, incident, synthetic, security signal) emits this shape. ops/monitor/run.mjs already emits the health/synthetic subset; runtime sources (Flutter/server) must conform to the same schema. STRICT RULE: no PII/secret — see forbiddenFields. Emitters must pass values through an allow-list (see ops/monitor/run.mjs safeDetails()).

event.source: monitor | flutter-ios | flutter-android | server | functions | github-actions (required)
event.eventType: health | runtime | deploy | incident | synthetic | security (required)
event.status: HEALTHY | DEGRADED | DOWN | UNKNOWN | PASS | FAIL | ''
event.errorCode: short UPPER_SNAKE code (e.g. RULES_DENY, APPCONFIG_MISSING, NOT_DEPLOYED, auth_failure_code) | null
event.correlationId: per-operation random UUID (NOT a userId) | runId (required)

correlationId.rule: A random per-operation UUID generated at the start of a client operation and propagated through the services it calls (app -> Firebase/server -> OpenAI), so one journey's events can be joined. MUST NOT be derived from userId/email/deviceId.

runtimeEventTypes.note: Phase 13 privacy-safe client telemetry — codes only, never content.

backendRuntimeEvent.note: Runtime Observability Phase 2 — Railway/Fastify backend runtime events. Emitted by the server (structured JSON stdout, redacted) and normalized by the read-only ops collector (ops/monitor/checks/railway-runtime-logs.mjs). SAFE FIELDS ONLY. Health-check events (eventType=health) stay SEPARATE from these runtime events.

fields.routeId: CANONICAL route template only (e.g. POST /feedbacks, GET /public/links/:code) — never a URL with a real code/value
fields.correlationId: opaque per-request id (Fastify request.id) — NEVER derived from email/userId/feedbackId/token

backendRuntimeEvent.gcpFunctionNote: source=gcp-functions events come from Google Cloud Logging (Logging v2 entries.list) for deployed Cloud Functions. Safe fields ONLY: service(function name)/region/severity/eventType/errorCode/gcpExecutionId/revision/resourceType. Raw textPayload/jsonPayload/stack are DROPPED after classification — NEVER srcIp / body / receipt / purchaseToken / JWT / email / secrets. errorCodes: FUNCTION_RUNTIME_ERROR/TIMEOUT/PERMISSION_DENIED/UNAVAILABLE/VALIDATION_ERROR. Requires (a) a deployed function and (b) a read-only GCP identity (WIF) -> GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.
backendRuntimeEvent.railwayHttpRequestNote: source=railway-http events come from Railway's httpLogs (the AUTHORITATIVE request-level source, independent of the app's stdout). Safe fields ONLY: method, routeId (canonicalized — never a real code), statusClass, httpStatus, latencyMs, railwayRequestId (Railway edge id — NOT the Fastify correlationId), deploymentId. NEVER srcIp / clientUa / query / headers (not even fetched from the API).
